step1.title: Welcome to Strive
step1.desc: Maximize your earnings as a VTC driver. Strive analyzes every offer so you never accept an unprofitable ride.

step2.title: Set up the scanner
step2.desc: Grant the accessibility and overlay permissions. A floating bubble will appear on top of your VTC app, ready to analyze offers.

step3.title: Accept or decline instantly
step3.desc: Tap the bubble when an offer appears. Strive shows the estimated hourly and km rates in real time. Green = go, Red = decline.

step4.title: Track your performance
step4.desc: The History and Analytics tabs show your daily earnings, acceptance rate, and your most profitable platforms.

step5.title: You're all set!
step5.desc: Configure your minimum rates in Preferences, then start the scanner from the Dashboard. Happy driving!

tips.step1: Strive works with Uber, Bolt and Heetch. More platforms are coming soon.
tips.step2: You'll need to grant 2 permissions: overlay and accessibility. Follow the step-by-step guide.
tips.step3: Pro tip: tap the bubble when an offer appears on your VTC app. No need to switch apps.
tips.step4: The Analytics tab shows daily earnings, platform breakdown and your real-time hourly rate.
tips.step5: Tip: start with a €20/hr minimum threshold, then adjust based on your actual results.

help.title: Help & Support
help.subtitle: Questions & Answers
help.contactDesc: A question not covered here? Write to us — we reply within 24h.

faq.a1: The scanner captures your VTC app's screen via the accessibility service, extracts trip details (fare, distance, duration) using OCR, and shows you a verdict based on your minimum rates.
faq.a2: Uber, Bolt and Heetch are currently supported. More platforms are coming soon.
faq.a3: Make sure both permissions are granted in the scanner setup screen: "Display over other apps" and "Accessibility service" must both be enabled.
faq.q4: How do I change my minimum rates?
faq.a4: Go to Profile → Trip Preferences. Adjust the sliders for hourly rate and per-km rate. Changes apply immediately.
faq.q5: How do I cancel my Plus subscription?
faq.a5: On Android: Google Play → Subscriptions. On iOS: Settings → Your name → Subscriptions. Find Strive and tap Cancel.
faq.a6: Pull down to refresh the Shop screen. If the issue persists, contact us at the address below.
